name: Infomart Corporation
summary: Infomart Corporation operates a business-to-business (BtoB) electronic commerce platform in Japan. The company operates in BtoB-PF FOOD business and BtoB-PFES business segments. The company offers BtoB Platform Invoices that digitalize both invoice receipt and issuance.; BtoB Platform Ordering for digitize everything from order placement to invoicing; BtoB platform TRADE to manage quotation, ordering, receiving, delivery, inspection, and invoicing operations digitally; BtoB Platform Ordering Lite for managing Order information from faxes, telephone calls, emails, and on the cloud; BtoB Platform Contract, a secure electronic contract service; TANOMU, a wholesale ordering system; and BP Storag…
